title: McpLense.Config.json
description: Unified configuration for the McpLense CLI: auth profiles, per-URL target bindings, URL-glob pattern overlays, and scan-pipeline configuration. Loaded from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/McpLense/McpLense.Config.json (or %APPDATA%\McpLense\McpLense.Config.json on Windows). The legacy filename 'McpLense.Profiles.json' is also accepted.

authProfiles.description: Named, reusable authentication recipes. Each profile describes HOW to authenticate, decoupled from any specific URL.

targets.description: Per-URL target bindings. Address one on the CLI with '@<name>' or by passing the matching URL positionally.

targetPatterns.description: URL-glob overlays applied to every command that opens an MCP connection. Lowest-priority layer of the header/target merge.

scan.description: Scan-pipeline configuration: per-check toggles + knobs and baseline output settings.

baselineDir.description: Base directory for '--baseline <path>' when path is a directory. Defaults to the current directory.

analysis.description: Findings/analysis layer configuration (consumed by 'mcplense analyze' and 'scan --findings'). Opinionated severities live here only; the scan checks stay fact-only.

failOn.description: Default CI-gate threshold: the process exits non-zero when any finding meets or exceeds it. '--fail-on' overrides this.

rules.description: Per-rule overrides keyed by rule id (e.g. 'prompt-injection', 'open-shape-input', 'weak-cors').

enabled.description: Turn this rule on or off (overrides its built-in default).

severity.description: Override the severity this rule assigns to its findings.

envString.description: Environment-expandable string. Forms: 'env:VAR' (whole-string, required), '${VAR}' (substring, required), '${VAR:-default}' (substring with default), '$$' (literal '$').

headersMap.description: HTTP header bag. Keys are header names; values are env-expandable strings.

scope.description: Whether per-target headers ride along with same-origin probes (CORS preflight, transport probe, authenticated-headers, DCR endpoint) in addition to the MCP session.

transport.description: HTTP transport mode for the MCP connection.

name.description: Profile identifier. Used with '--profile <name>' and as the default MSAL cache name.

priority.description: Tiebreaker rank for profile auto-pick. Higher wins. Built-in kind defaults: azure-cli=400, interactive-browser=300, oauth=200, bearer=100.

token.description: Static bearer token. Use env-expansion ('env:GITHUB_TOKEN') so secrets stay out of the config file.

issuer.description: Authorization server issuer URL. Required when the MCP server does not publish RFC 9728 PRM.

clientId.description: Pre-registered client id. Omit to attempt Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591).
Public-client app id (e.g. the VS Code GUID 'aebc6443-996d-45c2-90f0-388ff96faa56'). Required.

tenantId.description: Entra tenant. Omit to default to 'common'.

scopes.description: Entra scopes. The '<audience>/.default' form is automatically rewritten from the server's PRM when applicable.

cacheName.description: Override the MSAL cache key. Use 'mcp-proxy' to share state with mcp-proxy. Default: the profile name.

tenantId.description: Tenant override. Defaults to whatever 'az account show' reports.

scopes.description: Azure CLI '--resource' values. Each scope shells out to 'az account get-access-token --resource <scope>'.

url.description: MCP server URL. Headers also apply automatically when scanning this URL directly.

profile.description: Name of an authProfile to attach by default.

timeoutSeconds.description: Override the global --timeout for this target only.

disabledChecks.description: Check ids to suppress for this target. Unioned with CLI --disable.

match.description: URL glob. '*' matches one host label or one path segment, '**' matches any sequence including '/', '?' matches one char. Host part is case-insensitive; path part is case-sensitive. The scheme separator '://' is required.

checkConfig.description: Per-check configuration. The 'enabled' key is universal; the rest are check-specific knobs documented in docs/scan-checks.md.

enabled.description: Override the check's IsEnabledByDefault. CLI --enable / --disable wins over this.

observationDurationSeconds.description: behavior.serverInitiated: how long to keep the session open observing inbound notifications.

advertiseCapabilities.description: behavior.serverInitiated: which client-side capabilities to advertise during the handshake.

urlExtractionFields.description: metrics: which text fields to scan for URLs.
